name: 3/4 Sit-Up
cue: Sit right up, never lie back down
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up until your upper body is upright.
Lower yourself most of the way back, stopping before your shoulders touch the floor.
Sit straight back up from there.

name: Lying Leg Straightener
cue: Hold the thigh still, straighten the knee slowly
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and bend the hip and knee to a right angle.
Hold the back of that thigh with both hands.
Straighten the knee slowly, pushing the foot up towards the ceiling.
Bend it back to the start and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Legs-Up Groin Stretch
cue: Press knees in, then relax them wider
steps: Lie on your back on the floor and raise both legs towards the ceiling.
Open your legs into a wide V and rest your hands on the insides of your knees.
Press your knees inwards against your hands for a few seconds, without letting them move.
Relax your legs and let your hands ease them a little further apart.
Bring your legs together slowly, bend your knees and lower your feet to the floor.

name: Bicycle Crunch
cue: Elbow to opposite knee, pedal slowly
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your hands lightly beside your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and raise your knees above your hips, shins level.
Straighten one leg as you bring the opposite elbow towards the other knee.
Switch legs and bring your other elbow towards the other knee.
Keep alternating sides slowly, without pulling on your neck.

name: All Fours Quad Stretch
cue: Hold the foot, heel to bottom, hips forward
steps: Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees.
Lift one foot and reach back with the hand on that side to hold it.
Pull the heel towards your bottom, keeping your other hand under your shoulder.
Gently push your hips forward until you feel the stretch in the front of your thigh.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Alternate Hammer Curl
cue: Palms facing in, elbows pinned, alternate arms
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Turn your palms to face your body and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your palm facing in.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other one.
Keep alternating arms, moving only your forearms.

name: Alternate Heel Touch
cue: Shoulders up, reach side to side
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat, a little apart.
Rest your arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach one hand towards that heel by bending your upper body sideways.
Come back to the centre and reach to the other side.
Keep alternating sides, with your shoulders off the floor.

name: Front and Side Raise
cue: Front, then side, to shoulder height only
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise both weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly to your sides.
On the next rep, raise them out to your sides to shoulder height, then lower them slowly.
Keep alternating front and side.

name: Ankle On The Knee
cue: Ankle on knee, pull both legs in
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Reach through and hold the back of the lower thigh with both hands.
Pull both legs gently towards your chest until you feel the stretch in your buttock.
Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Arm Circles
cue: Arms out straight, small slow circles
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold your arms straight out to your sides at shoulder height.
Make small, slow circles forwards with both arms.
Then circle them backwards the same number of times.

name: Band Good Morning
cue: Hips back, back flat, stand up tall
steps: Stand on one end of a light band with your feet slightly apart.
Bend at your hips and loop the other end behind your neck, across your upper back, holding it there with both hands.
Keeping your back flat and your legs almost straight, stand up tall against the band.
Push your hips back to lean forward again, still with a flat back.
Keep your back flat as you stand up at the end.

name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
cue: Hips back, back flat, drive hips forward
steps: Loop one end of a light band round a desk leg, close to the floor, and the other behind your neck, holding it there with both hands.
Stand facing away from the desk and walk forward until the band is taut.
Push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back flat and your knees soft.
Drive your hips forward to stand up tall.
Keep your back flat throughout, including as you stand up at the end.

name: Band Inner Thigh Pull
cue: Pull straight leg in, upper body stays still
steps: Loop one end of the band round a desk leg, close to the floor, and the other round one ankle.
Stand side-on to the desk, a step away from it, with the band leg nearest, and hold its edge.
Let the band draw that leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pull the leg back in until your feet meet, keeping your upper body still.
Let it out again slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Pull Apart
cue: Arms straight, pull apart, shoulders stay down
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold the band in both hands, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Keeping your arms straight, pull your hands apart and out to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as the band reaches your chest.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
cue: Knees to chest, roll hips up slowly
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet just off the floor.
Keeping the bend in your knees, bring them in towards your chest.
Roll your hips up off the floor until your knees are over your chest.
Lower your hips and feet back down slowly.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
cue: Back flat, pull elbows back to your sides
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing you.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back flat and your head in line.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders.
Pull them up to your sides, elbows close to your body, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly, and keep your back flat as you stand up at the end.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In
cue: Back flat, palms in, pull elbows back
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back flat and your head in line.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders.
Pull them up to your sides, palms still facing in, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly, and keep your back flat as you stand up at the end.

name: Body-Up
cue: Forearm plank, press up onto your hands
steps: Lie face down on the floor, resting on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders.
Lift onto your toes into a forearm plank, body straight.
Press your palms into the floor and straighten your arms to lift your forearms off it.
Lower your forearms back down slowly, keeping your hips level.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cue: Sit back, chest up, knees out
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands behind your head.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to squat down.
Keep your chest up and push your knees out over your toes.
Go as low as is comfortable, then stand back up.

name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
cue: Long step, back knee down, chest up
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Step forward with one foot and bend both knees until your back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your chest up and your front knee over your front foot.
Push through your front heel and bring your back foot forward to stand.
Keep alternating legs; after a few steps forward, turn round and come back.

name: Tuck and Leg Raise
cue: Tuck knees, straighten legs up, lift hips
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms by your sides.
Tuck your knees in towards your chest.
Straighten your legs up towards the ceiling.
Lift your hips a little off the floor, then lower them.
Bend your knees and lower your legs slowly back to the floor.

name: Plank Butt-Up
cue: From plank, hips up high, lower without sagging
steps: Kneel on the floor and rest your forearms on it, elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time into a plank.
Lift your hips up high, keeping your forearms where they are.
Lower them slowly back to the plank, without letting your hips sag.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Glute Bridge
cue: Push through heels, lift hips, don't arch
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat, shoulder-width apart.
Rest your arms on the floor by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your back.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.

name: Band Calf Raise
cue: Hands at shoulders, rise onto toes, lower slowly
steps: Stand on the middle of the band with the balls of your feet, holding an end in each hand.
Raise your hands to your shoulders, palms forward and elbows bent.
Keeping your hands there, rise up onto your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels slowly.

name: Calf Stretch Elbows Against Wall
cue: Forearms on wall, heels stay down
steps: Stand facing a wall, a long step away from it.
Lean in and rest your forearms on the wall above your head.
Keep both heels on the floor and your body straight.
Step further back for a deeper stretch, or closer for a lighter one.

name: Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall
cue: Back heel down, body in one line
steps: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Lean forward and rest your hands on the wall.
Keep your back heel on the floor.
Keep your head, hips and back heel in one straight line.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Cat Stretch
cue: On all fours, round your back, head down
steps: Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees.
Place your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Pull your belly in and round your back up towards the ceiling.
Let your head drop and breathe.
Release slowly back to a flat back.

name: Chair Lower Back Stretch
cue: Hold the chair, lean sideways, arm over head
steps: Sit tall near the front of your chair with both feet flat.
Hold the side of the seat with one hand.
Raise your other arm straight up.
Lean towards the hand on the chair, reaching the raised arm over your head, until you feel the stretch.
Come back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Child's Pose
cue: Sit back on heels, arms long, relax
steps: Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees.
Walk your hands a little way forward.
Sit your hips back towards your heels, letting your arms slide along the floor.
Rest your forehead on the floor and breathe into your back.
Walk your hands back in to come up slowly.

name: Chin To Chest Stretch
cue: Hands behind head, chin gently to chest
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Interlace your fingers behind your head, elbows pointing forward.
Slowly pull your head down, bringing your chin towards your chest.
Keep the pull gentle and your back straight.
Release slowly and lift your head back up.

name: Clock Push-Up
cue: Small hop sideways each rep, land softly
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Lower your chest towards the floor, then push up briskly so your hands lift a little.
Move your hands a short way to one side and land softly, elbows slightly bent.
Step your feet round to follow, so you turn a little each rep.
Keep going round the same way, like the hand of a clock.

name: Cocoon Crunch
cue: Arms and knees meet over your middle
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms stretched out behind your head.
Bring your knees in towards your chest, lifting your hips slightly.
At the same time, curl your upper body up and bring your arms over towards your knees.
Pause briefly in the tuck.
Uncurl slowly back to lying long.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
cue: Shoulder to opposite knee, not just elbow
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your hands loosely behind your head.
Curl up, bringing one shoulder across towards the opposite knee as that knee comes in.
Lower back down slowly.
Repeat with the other shoulder and knee, and keep alternating sides.

name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
cue: Curl across to the opposite shoulder
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up and across your body towards the opposite shoulder.
Keep your palm facing in; don't twist your wrist.
Lower it slowly along the same path, then curl the other one.
Keep alternating arms.

name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
cue: Step back, sink, twist over front knee
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step back with one foot and bend both knees into a lunge.
As you sink, twist your upper body towards your front leg.
Turn back to face forward, then push through your front foot to step back to standing.
Keep alternating legs.

name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
cue: Arms stay beside your ears as you curl
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Stretch your arms up past your head, hands crossed.
Curl your shoulders just off the floor, keeping your arms in line with your head.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

name: Cuban Press
cue: Elbows up, turn weights up, press overhead
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back.
Lift your elbows out to shoulder height, forearms hanging down.
Keeping your elbows still, turn your forearms up until the weights are above your elbows.
Press the weights straight up above your head.
Reverse each step slowly to lower them.

name: Dancer's Stretch
cue: Hug bent knee, twist towards it, sit tall
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front of you.
Bend one knee and cross that foot over the straight leg, flat on the floor.
Place the hand on that side on the floor behind you.
Hook your other arm round the bent knee.
Sit tall and turn your upper body towards the bent knee.
Turn back slowly, then switch sides.

name: Dead Bug
cue: Back flat on the floor, one leg out
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your arms pointing up at the ceiling.
Lift your legs so your knees are over your hips and your shins are level.
Breathe out and press your lower back flat into the floor.
Straighten one leg out until it is just above the floor, keeping your back flat.
Bring it back in, then keep alternating legs.

name: Double Leg Butt Kick
cue: Jump, heels to bottom, land softly
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Dip into a quarter squat, then jump up.
Kick both heels up towards your bottom.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees as you land.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl
cue: Twist palm up as you curl
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keeping your elbow close to your side, curl one dumbbell up, turning your palm up as it rises.
Lower it slowly, turning your palm back in.
Curl the other one the same way.
Keep alternating arms.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
cue: Elbows pinned to sides, curl both up
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Turn your palms to face forward and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze briefly at the top.
Lower them slowly, moving only your forearms.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cue: Upper arms touch the floor, press up together
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and a light dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights straight up above your chest.
Lower them slowly until your upper arms rest on the floor.
Pause, then press them back up, bringing them together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
cue: Step forward, drop straight down, chest up
steps: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Take a long step forward with one foot.
Bend both knees to lower your hips, keeping your chest up and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to step back to standing.
Lead with the same leg until you finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row
cue: Elbow leads, weight close, up to chest
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in one hand, palm facing you, arm hanging in front.
Rest your free hand on your waist.
Lift the weight straight up close to your body, leading with your elbow.
Stop at about chest height, with your elbow higher than your hand.
Lower it slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Elbows-Up Side Raise
cue: Elbows lead, lift weights up your sides
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing back.
Leading with your elbows, lift the weights up the sides of your body.
Stop at about chest height, with your elbows higher than your hands.
Lower them back down slowly.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
cue: Step back, drop straight down, chest up
steps: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Take a long step back with one foot.
Bend both knees to lower your hips, keeping your chest up and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front foot to step back to standing.
Lead with the same leg until you finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Thumbs-Up Raise
cue: Thumbs up, raise arms in a wide V
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them forward and out at an angle, in a wide V.
Stop when your hands reach shoulder height.
Lower them slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Shoulders up to ears, arms stay straight
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your shoulders slowly.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
cue: Bend sideways only, no leaning forward
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and a light dumbbell in one hand by your side.
Rest your other hand on your waist or behind your head.
Keeping your back straight, bend sideways towards the dumbbell as far as is comfortable.
Come back up through centre and bend slightly the other way.
Return to centre and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Squat
cue: Sit back, chest up, heels down
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
Keeping your chest up and your back straight, bend your knees and sit your hips back.
Lower until your thighs are about level with the floor, or as far as is comfortable.
Push through your heels to stand back up.

name: Dynamic Back Stretch
cue: Straight arms swing up smoothly, no jerking
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, swing them forward and up above your head.
Keep the swing smooth and controlled, going only as high as is comfortable.
Lower them back down the same way.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
cue: Straight arms open wide, then back, controlled
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, hands together.
Keeping your arms straight, open them out wide to your sides at shoulder height.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across your chest.
Bring them back together in front of you at a steady, controlled pace.

name: Elbow Circles
cue: Fingers on shoulders, draw slow elbow circles
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Rest your fingertips on your shoulders, elbows out at shoulder height.
Slowly draw big circles forwards with your elbows, breathing steadily.
Then circle them backwards the same number of times.

name: Crossed-Leg Elbow to Knee
cue: Leg crossed, twist elbow to raised knee
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Clasp your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and twist, bringing the opposite elbow towards the crossed knee.
Lower back down slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Elbows Back
cue: Hands on lower back, draw elbows together
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing down and elbows out.
Gently draw your elbows back towards each other until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your chest lifted and your shoulders down.
Release slowly.

name: Fast Skipping
cue: Quick low skips, stay light on your feet
steps: Stand tall with one foot slightly in front of the other.
Skip on the spot, stepping onto one foot and giving a small hop on it.
Step onto the other foot and hop on that one.
Keep alternating feet with quick, low skips, landing lightly on the balls of your feet.

name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
cue: Body straight, lower slowly, catch with hands
steps: Kneel on the floor and hook your heels under something stable, such as a sofa or a heavy desk.
Cross your arms on your chest and keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, without bending at the hips.
When you can't control it any further, catch yourself on your hands.
Push lightly off the floor to help yourself back up.

name: Freehand Jump Squat
cue: Squat, jump straight up, land softly
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and cross your arms over your chest.
Squat down, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Push through the balls of your feet and jump straight up.
Land softly with bent knees, sinking straight into the next squat.

name: Frog Hop
cue: Low squat, hop forward, land softly
steps: Stand with your hands resting lightly behind your head.
Squat down, keeping your chest and head up.
Hop forward a short way, staying low rather than jumping high.
Land softly, bending your knees into the squat, and hop again.
After a few hops, turn round and hop back.

name: Frog Sit-Up
cue: Soles together, knees out, curl up a little
steps: Lie on your back on the floor.
Bend your knees, let them fall out to the sides and press the soles of your feet together.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor and curl your shoulders up off it.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly.

name: Alternating Front Raise
cue: One arm up front, body stays still
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
With a slight bend in your elbow, raise one weight in front of you to just above shoulder height, palm down.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other one.
Keep alternating arms without swinging your body.

name: Front Leg Raise
cue: Straight leg forward and back, under control
steps: Stand side-on to a chair back or desk and hold it with one hand.
Keeping your outside leg straight, raise it forward under control.
Lower it and let it move back behind you, without flinging it.
Keep your upper body tall throughout.
Keep the movement smooth and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Front Two-Dumbbell Raise
cue: Both arms up front, no swinging
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both weights in front of you to just above shoulder height, palms down.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower them slowly, keeping your body still.

name: Glute Kickback
cue: Knee stays bent, heel to ceiling, back flat
steps: Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders.
Keeping the knee bent, lift one leg until your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your buttock at the top, without arching your lower back.
Lower the knee back down slowly.
Keep alternating legs.

name: Groin and Back Stretch
cue: Hands behind head, curl elbows between knees
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet together.
Interlace your fingers behind your head, keeping the hold light.
Curl down slowly, reaching your elbows towards the insides of your knees until you feel the stretch.
Pause briefly, then sit back up tall with your head up.

name: Plank Jump-In
cue: Hop feet to hands, land softly, head up
steps: Start in a push-up position on the floor, hands under your shoulders and body straight.
Jump both feet forward, landing softly beside your hands.
Keep your head up and your hands planted.
Jump your feet back to the push-up position, landing softly.

name: Hammer Curl
cue: Palms in, curl both, elbows still
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Turn your palms to face your body and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up towards your shoulders, palms still facing in.
Lower them slowly, moving only your forearms.

name: Strap Hamstring Stretch
cue: Strap round foot, leg straight, pull gently
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with both legs straight.
Loop a belt, towel or band round the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg towards the ceiling, keeping your other leg flat on the floor.
Pull gently on the strap, drawing the leg towards you until you feel the stretch in the back of your thigh.
Lower the leg slowly, then switch sides.

name: Handstand Push-Up
cue: Lower slowly, stop before your head touches
steps: Clear the floor in front of a wall and lay a folded towel just in front of it.
Stand with your back to the wall, bend forward and place your hands on the floor, shoulder-width apart, either side of the towel.
Kick up one leg at a time until your heels rest on the wall, with your arms and body straight.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower your head towards the towel, stopping before it touches.
Push back up slowly until your arms are straight again.
Step your feet down one at a time to finish.

name: All Fours Hip Circle
cue: Knee off the floor, draw big slow circles
steps: Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees.
Lift one knee slightly off the floor, keeping it bent.
Draw a big, slow circle with that knee, keeping your back still.
Reverse the direction halfway and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Leg Kickback
cue: Straight leg back slowly, back stays still
steps: Loop one end of the band round a desk leg, close to the floor, and the other round one ankle.
Stand facing the desk, a step back from it, and hold its edge.
Keep your chest up and the band leg straight.
Move that leg back slowly, as far as you can without arching your lower back.
Bring it forward again slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Knee Raise
cue: Knee up to hip height, chest stays up
steps: Loop one end of the band round a desk leg, close to the floor, and the other round one ankle.
Stand with your back to the desk, a step away from it, and rest a hand on a wall or chair back.
Keeping your chest up, raise the band knee in front of you to hip height.
Pause, then lower it slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Hug Knees To Chest
cue: Hold behind knees, pull them in gently
steps: Lie on your back on the floor.
Bring both knees up towards your chest.
Hold your legs behind the knees, not over them.
Gently pull your knees towards your shoulders and relax your back.
Release slowly and lower your feet to the floor.

name: Inchworm
cue: Walk hands out, walk feet in, hips level
steps: Stand with your feet together.
Bend forward and put your hands on the floor, bending your knees as much as you need.
Walk your hands forward slowly until your body is straight, as in a push-up.
Keep your hands still and walk your feet in with small steps, legs as straight as is comfortable.
Walk your hands out again from there, and roll up to standing at the end.

name: Iron Cross
cue: Squat with arms forward, stand and open wide
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a light dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back into a squat, keeping your chest up.
Stand up and open your arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Bring your arms back to the front as you squat again.

name: Scorpion Stretch
cue: Shoulders down, foot slowly across to other hand
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms straight out to the sides, palms down.
Bend one knee and slowly lift that leg across the back of your body.
Reach your foot towards the floor near your opposite hand until you feel the stretch.
Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Bring the leg back slowly and keep alternating sides.

name: Chest Squeeze
cue: Press palms together hard, keep breathing
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Bend your arms and press your palms together in front of your chest, fingers pointing forward.
Push your hands into each other, building the squeeze slowly.
Keep breathing normally while you squeeze.
Release the tension slowly.

name: Front and Back Neck Press
cue: Head pushes into hands, head doesn't move
steps: Sit or stand tall, head level and facing forward.
Place both hands on your forehead; for the other side, clasp them behind your head.
Push your head gently into your hands, building the pressure slowly.
Resist with your hands so your head doesn't move, and keep breathing.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side Neck Press
cue: Push head into hand, head stays still
steps: Sit or stand tall, head level and facing forward.
Place one hand on the side of your head, above the ear.
Push your head gently sideways into your hand, building the pressure slowly.
Resist with your hand so your head doesn't move, and keep breathing.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side-to-Side Push-Up
cue: Shift side to side, body stays straight
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that elbow to lower your chest towards that hand.
Push back to the centre, then shift to the other side.
Keep alternating sides.

name: Jackknife Sit-Up
cue: Lift arms and straight legs to meet
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms stretched out behind your head.
Breathe out and lift your straight legs and your upper body at the same time.
Reach your hands towards your shins as they meet.
Lower your arms and legs back down slowly.

name: Slow Sit-Up
cue: Squeeze your bottom, rise very slowly
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Squeeze your bottom and the backs of your legs firmly.
Breathe out as you sit up very slowly, keeping the squeeze.
Breathe in as you lower back down slowly.

name: Knee Across The Body
cue: Knee across, shoulders stay down, head turns away
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight.
Bend one knee and lower it across your body towards the floor.
Hold that knee down gently with your opposite hand; it needn't touch the floor.
Rest your other arm out to the side and turn your head towards it.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Knee Circles
cue: Feet together, knees soft, circle both knees
steps: Stand with your feet together and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly.
Circle both knees together in one direction, breathing normally.
Then circle them the other way the same number of times.

name: Knee Tuck Jump
cue: Jump, knees up to hands, land softly
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hold your hands out in front of your chest, palms down.
Dip into a quarter squat, then jump up.
Bring your knees up towards your hands.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees as you land.

name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
cue: Fingers towards knees, palms flat, lean back
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your palms flat in front of your knees.
Turn your hands so your fingers point back towards your knees.
Keeping your palms flat, lean back slowly until you feel the stretch in your forearms.
Come forward again slowly to release.

name: Kneeling Lunge Stretch
cue: Chest up, shift hips forward, don't arch
steps: Kneel on the floor, then step one foot forward so that knee is bent at a right angle.
Rest the top of your back foot on the floor and your hands on your hips.
Keep your chest up and tuck your hips under slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of your back hip.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Lateral Bound
cue: Bound sideways, land softly on one foot
steps: Stand in a half squat with clear space on either side.
Shift your weight onto one leg and push off it, bounding a short way sideways.
Land softly on the other foot, bending that knee as you land.
Push off that foot to bound back the other way.
Keep bounding from side to side, landing softly each time.

name: Band Lateral Raise
cue: Arms out to shoulder height, no shrugging
steps: Sit or stand tall, with the middle of the band under both feet.
Hold an end in each hand by your sides, palms in and elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height.
Lower them slowly.

name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
cue: Hold the thigh, straighten the knee, ease in
steps: Lie on your back on the floor, bend one knee and put that foot flat.
Raise your other leg and hold the back of the thigh with both hands.
Straighten that knee as far as is comfortable, sole towards the ceiling.
Gently pull the leg towards you until you feel the stretch in the back of your thigh.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Leg Pull-In
cue: Pull knees to chest, shins stay level
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees and pull your thighs in until your knees are over your chest.
Keep your shins level with the floor as they come in.
Pause briefly at the top.
Straighten your legs back out slowly.

name: Wall Knee Drive
cue: Lean on the wall, drive knees up
steps: Place your hands on a wall at shoulder height and step your feet back.
Lean into the wall with your body in a straight line, up on the balls of your feet.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then drive that foot back down under your hips.
Switch legs, lifting the other knee.
Keep alternating legs at a quick, steady rhythm.

name: Looking At Ceiling
cue: Hands on heels, hips forward, look up
steps: Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and your toes tucked under.
Reach back towards your heels with both hands, one at a time, and hold them if you can.
Push your hips gently forward and lift your chest.
Tip your head back slowly to look at the ceiling.
Let go one hand at a time and come back up slowly.

name: Face-Down Chest Lift
cue: Lift chest without pushing on hands
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms by your sides.
Lift your chest off the floor, keeping your hips down.
Keep your head in line and don't push up with your hands.
Lower your chest back down slowly.

name: Lying Crossover
cue: Press knee into hand, then ease it down
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and cross it over your body towards the floor.
Hold that knee with your opposite hand, keeping both shoulders down.
Press the knee up into your hand for a few seconds, without letting it move.
Relax the leg and let your hand ease the knee a little closer to the floor.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Lying Glute Stretch
cue: Press leg into hands, then pull it in
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight.
Bend one knee and lift it, turning the leg out so the foot crosses over your other hip.
Hold the knee with one hand and the ankle with the other.
Push the leg away into your hands for a few seconds, without letting it move.
Relax, then gently pull the knee and ankle towards your chest.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Face-Down Quad Stretch
cue: Press foot into hand, then heel to bottom
steps: Lie face down on the floor, resting your forehead on one forearm.
Bend one knee and reach back with the hand on that side to hold the ankle.
Push your foot back into your hand for a few seconds, without letting it move.
Relax, then gently pull the heel towards your bottom.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Middle Back Stretch
cue: Hands on hips, twist, hips face forward
steps: Sit or stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Keeping your hips facing forward, twist your upper body to one side until you feel the stretch.
Keep your back tall and breathe.
Turn back to centre slowly, then switch sides.

name: Monster Walk
cue: Small steps, feet wide, keep the band tight
steps: Loop the band round both legs, just above your ankles.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart so the band is taut, knees slightly bent.
Take small steps forward, alternating feet and keeping the band taut.
After a few steps, walk backwards to where you started.

name: Mountain Climber
cue: Hips level, drive knees in, swap quickly
steps: Start in a push-up position on the floor, hands under your shoulders.
Bring one knee in under your chest, resting on the ball of that foot.
Swap legs quickly, driving the other knee in as the first goes back.
Keep your hips level and your hands planted.
Keep alternating legs.

name: Feet-Up Twist Crunch
cue: Feet up on chair, elbow to opposite knee
steps: Lie on your back on the floor and rest your feet on a chair seat, knees bent.
Place one hand beside your head and rest the other arm on the floor.
Curl up, lifting the shoulder of the raised hand.
Bring that elbow towards the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Crunch
cue: On your side, lift elbow towards hip
steps: Lie on one side on the floor with your legs stacked and your knees slightly bent.
Place your top hand behind your head.
Lift your top elbow and shoulder up towards your hip.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: On Your Side Quad Stretch
cue: Hold top foot, push hip forward gently
steps: Lie on your side on the floor and rest your head on your lower arm.
Bend your lower knee in front of you to steady yourself.
Bend your top knee and hold that foot behind you with your top hand.
Press your top hip forward as you push your foot back into your hand.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: One Arm Against Wall
cue: Elbow high on the wall, lean in gently
steps: Stand facing a wall or doorway, a small step away from it.
Place one forearm on the wall above your head, elbow bent.
Slowly lean your chest towards the wall until you feel the stretch down the side of your back.
Ease back slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Half Locust
cue: Pull top foot back, chest lifts
steps: Lie on your side on the floor, propped up on your lower forearm.
Keep your lower leg straight along the floor.
Bend your top knee and reach back with your top hand to hold that foot.
Lift your chest and gently pull the foot back until you feel the stretch in the front of your thigh.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: One Knee To Chest
cue: Pull one knee in, other leg stays long
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with both legs straight.
Bend one knee and hold the back of that thigh, just under the knee.
Gently pull the knee towards your chest.
Keep your other leg straight and resting on the floor.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Overhead Stretch
cue: Lace fingers, palms up, shoulders stay down
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Lace your fingers together and turn your palms to the ceiling.
Push your hands up overhead, keeping your shoulders down.
Draw your belly in gently and lengthen up through your whole body, without arching your back.
Release slowly and lower your arms.

name: Triceps Press and Stretch
cue: Press elbow into hand, then ease it back
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Raise one arm, bend the elbow and let your hand drop behind your head.
Hold that elbow with your other hand.
Press the elbow up into your hand for a few seconds, without letting it move.
Relax the arm, then gently pull the elbow further behind your head.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
cue: Tilt hips first, then peel the back up
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your heels under your knees.
Pull your belly in and tilt your tailbone up, flattening your lower back.
Keep lifting, raising your back off the floor bit by bit into a bridge.
Keep your head and shoulders on the floor.
Lower your back down slowly, one part at a time.

name: Plank
cue: Forearms down, body straight, hips don't sag
steps: Kneel on the floor and rest your forearms on it, elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Hold your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your hips level, neither sagging nor raised, and breathe.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Plie Dumbbell Squat
cue: Feet wide, toes out, knees follow toes
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders, toes pointing out.
Hold one light dumbbell by one end with both hands, arms hanging in front of you.
Keeping your chest up, bend your knees out over your toes and lower your hips.
Stop when your thighs are about level with the floor, or as far as is comfortable.
Push through your heels to stand back up.

name: Plyo Push-up
cue: Push up briskly, hands lift, land softly
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Keeping your body straight, lower your chest towards the floor.
Push up briskly so your hands leave the floor just a little.
Land softly on your hands with your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Straight-Arm Side Raise
cue: Arms straight, lift out to shoulder height
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing in.
Keeping your arms straight, lift the weights out to your sides to shoulder height.
Keep your palms facing down at the top.
Lower them slowly.

name: Crossed-Ankle Leg Curl
cue: Curl heel up, other leg pushes against it
steps: Lie face down on the floor, resting your head on your forearms.
Cross your ankles, with the other leg's ankle resting on the back of the working one.
Bend the working knee to lift that foot towards your bottom, pushing down against it with the top leg.
Lower it slowly, still resisting, and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Wide Push-Up
cue: Hands wide, body straight, hips don't sag
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Keeping your body straight, bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Close-Hand Push-Up
cue: Hands close, elbows tuck in by your sides
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands close together under your chest.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Keeping your body straight, bend your elbows to lower your chest towards your hands.
Keep your elbows close to your sides as you push back up.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Push Up to Side Plank
cue: Push up, then turn and reach up
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands just wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Keeping your body straight, lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up.
Turn onto one hand and the sides of your feet, reaching your other arm up.
Bring that hand back down, do another push-up and turn to the other side.
Keep alternating sides.

name: Push-Up
cue: Body straight, chest towards the floor
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes.
Keeping your body straight, bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Close and Wide Push-Up
cue: Switch hands between close and wide each rep
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands close together under your chest.
Step your feet back one at a time, resting on your toes, body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up.
Walk your hands out wider than your shoulders and do the next push-up.
Keep alternating between close and wide hands.
Lower your knees to the floor to finish.

name: Rear Leg Raise
cue: Leg straight back and up, back flat
steps: Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders.
Straighten one leg and lift it up behind you until it's in line with your back.
Keep your back flat; don't arch to lift the leg higher.
Lower the knee back down slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Reverse Crunch
cue: Roll hips up, arms stay flat
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your legs so your thighs point up and your shins are level.
Roll your hips up off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause briefly, then lower your hips back down slowly.

name: Rocket Jump
cue: Squat halfway, jump, reach both arms overhead
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms close to your sides.
Squat down halfway.
Jump straight up, reaching both arms overhead.
Land softly with bent knees, bringing your arms back down.

name: Runner's Stretch
cue: Front toes up, hinge, reach towards foot
steps: Stand tall and step one foot a short way forward.
Rest that heel on the floor with the knee straight and your toes pointing up.
Bend your back knee slightly.
Lean forward from your hips and reach towards your front foot until you feel the stretch.
Come back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Scissor Kick
cue: Lower back down, legs switch up and down
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your arms out to your sides, palms down.
Lift your heels just off the floor, knees slightly bent.
Raise one leg higher while the other stays just above the floor.
Switch legs, keeping your lower back pressed down.
Keep alternating legs, breathing steadily.

name: Scissors Jump
cue: Jump from a lunge, switch legs, land softly
steps: Stand tall, then take a long step forward with one foot.
Bend both knees to lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Swing your arms and jump up off both feet.
Switch your legs in the air and land softly in a lunge with the other foot forward.
Keep alternating legs.

name: Behind-the-Back Biceps Stretch
cue: Arms straight behind, palms in, lift gently
steps: Sit or stand tall; if sitting, move to the front of your chair.
Reach both arms straight behind you, palms facing each other.
Keeping your elbows straight, slowly lift your hands until you feel the stretch in the front of your arms.
For an easier version, rest your hands on the edge of a desk behind you instead.
Release slowly and lower your arms.

name: Floor Calf Stretch
cue: Toes pulled back, reach forward, back long
steps: Sit tall on the floor with your legs straight out in front.
Bend one knee and put that foot flat on the floor.
Pull the toes of your straight leg up towards you.
Reach towards those toes with both hands until you feel the stretch in your calf; a belt or towel round the foot helps if they're out of reach.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: One-Leg Floor Hamstring Stretch
cue: Lean from the hips, reach towards your ankle
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front.
Bend your other knee and rest that foot against the inside of your straight thigh.
Sit tall, then lean forward from your hips.
Reach towards the ankle of the straight leg until you feel the stretch in the back of your thigh.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Front Shoulder Stretch
cue: Straight arms back, chest open, palms down
steps: Sit or stand tall; if sitting, move to the front of your chair.
Hold your arms straight out to your sides, palms facing down.
Keeping your elbows straight, draw your arms back behind you until you feel the stretch across the front of your shoulders.
Keep your chest lifted and your shoulders down.
Release slowly and lower your arms.

name: Seated Glute Stretch
cue: Ankle on knee, lean forward, back flat
steps: Sit near the front of your chair with both feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit tall, then lean forward from your hips with a flat back.
Stop when you feel the stretch in the buttock of the crossed leg.
Sit back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Floor Hamstring Press and Stretch
cue: Push back into your grip, then lean further
steps: Sit on the floor with both legs straight out in front.
Lean forward from your hips and hold your shins wherever you can reach.
Try to sit back up against your grip for a few seconds, without letting your body move.
Relax, then lean a little further forward until you feel the stretch in the back of your thighs.
Let go and sit up slowly.

name: Butterfly Side Stretch
cue: Elbow up to ceiling, lean sideways
steps: Sit tall on the floor with the soles of your feet together in front of you.
Place one hand on the floor beside you.
Put your other hand behind your head.
Lift that elbow towards the ceiling as you lean towards the hand on the floor.
Come back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: See-Saw Press
cue: Press one arm up, lean the other way
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing you.
Press one weight up, turning your palm forward, as you lean your body to the other side.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you come upright.
Press the other weight the same way, leaning the opposite way.
Keep alternating sides.

name: Shoulder Circles
cue: Roll shoulders slowly, arms stay relaxed
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Slowly roll both shoulders forward, up, back and down in one smooth circle.
Then roll them the other way the same number of times.

name: Band Shoulder Press
cue: Press straight up, don't arch your back
steps: Sit or stand tall, with the middle of the band under both feet.
Hold an end in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward and elbows bent.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Shoulder Raise
cue: Shoulders up to ears, then fully down
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift both shoulders up towards your ears.
Lower them slowly all the way down.
Keep your arms loose and your neck long throughout.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cue: Straight arm across, pull above the elbow
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Reach one arm straight across your body at chest height.
Hold it just above the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull it towards your chest until you feel the stretch in the back of your shoulder.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Floor Stretch
cue: Hold top wrist, pull gently, lengthen your side
steps: Lie on one side on the floor and bend your lower knee in front of you.
Straighten your top leg and rest that foot on the floor behind you.
Reach both arms over your head and hold your top wrist with your lower hand.
Pull the wrist gently until you feel the stretch along your top side.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side Plank
cue: Hips lifted, body straight, don't drop
steps: Lie on one side on the floor, resting on your forearm with your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your legs and put your top hand on your hip.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from head to feet.
Keep your hips up and breathe.
Lower your hips to the floor, then switch sides.

name: Side Jackknife
cue: Top leg and elbow lift to meet
steps: Lie on one side on the floor, legs straight, resting on your lower arm.
Place your top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg as you crunch your elbow towards it.
Lower both back down slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Side Raise
cue: Lift out to the sides, no swinging
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing in.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lift the weights out to your sides.
Stop at shoulder height, tilting the front of each weight slightly down.
Lower them slowly, without swinging your body.

name: Front Raise and Side Sweep
cue: Raise in front, sweep out, lower slowly
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Keeping them at that height, sweep your arms out to your sides.
Lower them slowly from your sides.

name: Side Leg Raise
cue: Straight leg out to the side, stay tall
steps: Stand facing a chair back or desk and hold it with both hands.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Keeping the other leg straight, raise it out to the side under control.
Lower it again, letting it cross slightly in front of your standing leg.
Keep the movement smooth and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Side Lying Groin Stretch
cue: Top leg up, ease it towards your shoulder
steps: Lie on your side on the floor with your legs straight and your head resting on your lower hand.
Lift your top leg towards the ceiling and hold it behind the knee with your top hand.
Gently pull the leg towards your shoulder until you feel the stretch on the inside of your thigh.
Keep your hips stacked; don't roll backwards.
Lower the leg slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side Neck Stretch
cue: Ear to shoulder, shoulders stay down
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Gently tilt your head towards one shoulder.
For a deeper stretch, rest that hand on the side of your head and pull gently.
Come back to centre slowly, then switch sides.

name: Side Standing Long Jump
cue: Jump sideways off both feet, land softly
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees and hips slightly bent, with clear space to one side.
Swing your arms and jump a short way sideways off both feet.
Land softly on both feet, bending your knees as you land.
Jump back the other way to where you started.
Keep jumping from side to side.

name: Side Wrist Pull
cue: Hold wrist, pull across and up gently
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Bring one arm across your body and hold that wrist with your other hand, low by your hip.
Slowly straighten the arm and pull it across and up to shoulder height.
Stop when you feel the stretch across your upper back, without pulling hard on the shoulder.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Single-Arm Push-Up
cue: Feet wide, lower slowly, hips stay level
steps: Kneel on the floor with one hand under your shoulder and the other behind your back.
Step your feet back and wide apart, resting on your toes.
Lower your chest slowly towards the floor, only as far as you can control.
Push back up to a straight arm and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Single Dumbbell Raise
cue: Both hands on one weight, arms straight
steps: Sit or stand tall, holding one light dumbbell by one end with both hands, arms hanging in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the weight in front of you and up over your head.
Keep your body still as you lift.
Lower it slowly along the same path.

name: Single Leg Butt Kick
cue: Hop, heel to bottom, land softly
steps: Stand beside a desk or wall and rest one hand on it.
Lift your outside knee and keep it raised.
Dip slightly on your standing leg, then hop up off it.
Kick that heel up towards your bottom as you rise.
Land softly on the same foot with a bent knee and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
cue: Push through one heel, hips stay level
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Lift one leg and straighten it towards the ceiling.
Push through the heel of your other foot to lift your hips off the floor.
Lift until your body is straight from shoulders to knee, keeping your hips level.
Lower slowly and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Sit-Up
cue: Hands behind head, don't pull your neck
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Tuck your feet under a sofa or heavy chair if you like.
Clasp your fingers lightly behind your head.
Sit up until your body and thighs make a V.
Lower yourself back down slowly.

name: Sit Squat
cue: Sit back halfway, then stand up
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms out in front.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Stop partway down, well above a full squat.
Stand back up smoothly.

name: Spell Caster
cue: Slow turn, carry weights hip to hip
steps: Stand with your feet wide, holding a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back.
Bring both dumbbells to one side, next to your hip, turning your upper body that way.
Turn slowly to the other side, sweeping both weights up and across in front of you to the other hip.
Keep the move smooth and controlled, letting your back heel turn with you.
Keep alternating sides.

name: Spider Crawl
cue: Low push-up, knee out to elbow
steps: Get into a push-up position on your hands and toes, body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself partway.
Lift one foot and bring that knee out to the side, up towards the same elbow.
Return the foot to the floor.
Keep alternating legs, holding your body low and straight.

name: Spinal Stretch
cue: Hands behind head, twist, lean elbow to knee
steps: Sit tall near the front of your chair, feet flat and apart.
Interlace your fingers behind your head, elbows out and chin slightly down.
Twist your upper body to one side.
Lean forward and reach the lower elbow towards the floor inside your knee until you feel the stretch.
Sit back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Split Jump
cue: Jump from a lunge, same foot stays forward
steps: Stand tall, then take a long step forward with one foot.
Bend both knees to lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Swing your arms and jump up off both feet.
Land softly back in the same lunge, bending your knees as you land.
Finish your reps and step your feet together, then switch sides.

name: Split Squat
cue: Feet stay planted, drop straight down, chest up
steps: Stand tall, then take a long step forward with one foot.
Lift your back heel so you rest on the ball of that foot.
Keeping your chest up, bend both knees to lower your hips straight down.
Push through your front foot to rise again, keeping your feet where they are.
Finish your reps and step your feet together, then switch sides.

name: Band Squat
cue: Hands at shoulders, sit back, chest up
steps: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold an end in each hand and raise them to your shoulders, palms forward.
Squat down, sitting your hips back and keeping your chest up.
Push through your heels to stand back up.

name: Alternating Shoulder Press
cue: Press one weight up, no leaning
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows out.
Press one weight straight up, keeping the other in place.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Press the other one the same way.
Keep alternating arms without leaning or jerking.

name: Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Back flat, elbow still, straighten arm back
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in one hand, palm facing you.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back flat, and rest your free hand on your thigh.
Lift the working elbow to your side, upper arm level with your back and forearm hanging down.
Keeping the elbow still, straighten your arm back, then lower the weight slowly.
Keep your back flat as you stand up when you finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Back flat, elbows still, straighten arms back
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing you.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back flat and your head in line.
Lift your elbows to your sides, upper arms level with your back and forearms hanging down.
Keeping your elbows still, straighten both arms back, then lower the weights slowly.
Keep your back flat as you stand up at the end.

name: Standing Concentration Curl
cue: Back flat, upper arm still, curl to chest
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in one hand and stand with your feet wide, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward, keeping your back flat, and rest your free hand on your thigh.
Let the weight hang straight down below your shoulder.
Keeping your upper arm still, curl the weight up towards your chest, then lower it slowly.
Keep your back flat as you stand up when you finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
cue: Rise onto your toes, lower slowly
steps: Stand tall on a flat floor, or with the balls of your feet on a small step; a book or a stair works.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Press both straight up, don't lean back
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at head height, elbows bent and out to the sides.
Press both weights straight up above your head.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower them slowly to head height, without leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
cue: Palms down, curl up, elbows still
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Hold them with your palms facing back, knuckles forward.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl both dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Lower them slowly, keeping your palms facing down.

name: Overhead Front Raise
cue: Arms long, raise in front to overhead
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Keep your arms straight, with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you and up until they are above your head.
Lower them slowly along the same path.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Elbows in, lower behind head, press up
steps: Sit or stand tall, cupping one end of a light dumbbell in both hands.
Lift it straight above your head, arms fully stretched.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
cue: Elbows lead, weights close, up to chest
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Lift the weights straight up close to your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop at about chest height, with your elbows higher than your hands.
Lower them slowly.

name: Standing Calf Stretch
cue: Heel raised, back straight, pull toes back
steps: Stand facing a small step; a book, a stair or a door threshold works.
Rest one heel on it with that knee straight and your toes pointing up.
Bend your other knee slightly and rest that hand on your thigh.
Keeping your back straight, lean forward and reach for the toes of the raised foot.
Pull those toes gently towards your knee until you feel the stretch in your calf.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Standing Hip Circles
cue: Hold on, draw slow big circles with knee
steps: Stand side-on to a desk or wall and hold it with one hand.
Raise your outside knee in front of you to hip height.
Slowly move that knee out to the side, drawing a big circle with it.
Bring it back round to the front.
Keep the circles slow and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
cue: Tuck hips under, press forward, stay tall
steps: Stand tall and take a long step forward with one foot.
Lift your back heel off the floor.
Bend both knees to lower your hips a little.
Tuck your hips under and press them forward until you feel the stretch at the front of your back hip.
Come back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Inner-Biceps Curl
cue: Curl out wide, turning palms up
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl both dumbbells up and slightly outwards.
Turn your palms up as they rise, ending in line with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly, turning your palms back in.

name: Side Stretch
cue: Hand behind head, lean sideways, hips stay still
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Rest one hand on your hip.
Raise your other arm and place that hand behind your head.
Lean your upper body sideways, away from the raised elbow, without leaning forward.
Keep your hips still and your weight even.
Come back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Standing Long Jump
cue: Swing arms, jump forward, land softly
steps: Stand in a partial squat with your feet shoulder-width apart and clear space in front.
Swing your arms back, then swing them forward and jump a short way forward.
Land softly on both feet, bending your knees as you land.
Turn round and jump back to where you started.

name: One-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Elbow points up, lower behind head
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in one hand.
Raise that arm straight above your head, palm facing forward.
Keeping your upper arm close to your head, bend the elbow to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten your arm to press it back up.
Bring the weight down when you finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Palms-In Shoulder Press
cue: Palms face each other, press straight up
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
Press both weights straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Keep your palms facing each other throughout.

name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
cue: Knees soft, tuck hips under, back flattens
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly, keeping them soft.
Gently rock your hips forward and back to find the movement.
Then tuck your tailbone under so your lower back flattens, and hold.
Keep breathing, then release slowly.

name: Bent-Knee Calf Stretch
cue: Bend both knees, back heel stays down
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor.
Sink a little lower until you feel the stretch low in your back calf.
Come back up slowly, then switch sides.

name: Standing Toe Reach
cue: Hang forward, legs straight, let your head relax
steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Bend forward from your hips, keeping your legs straight but not locked.
Let your arms hang and reach towards your toes until you feel the stretch.
Relax your head and neck and breathe.
Roll up slowly to stand.

name: Towel Triceps Extension
cue: Elbow stays up, lower hand pulls against you
steps: Sit or stand tall, holding a towel.
Raise one arm and hold the top of the towel, letting it hang down your back.
Reach behind your back with your other hand and grip the lower end.
Bend the top elbow to lower your hand behind your head, keeping the elbow pointing up.
Straighten the arm again while your lower hand pulls the towel down against it.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Star Jump
cue: Squat, jump up, spread arms and legs
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Squat down halfway.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs wide.
Bring your arms and legs back in as you land, with soft knees.

name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
cue: Back flat, hips back, weights down your legs
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keeping your knees still and your back flat, push your hips back and lower the weights down the front of your legs.
Reach towards your feet until you feel the stretch in the back of your thighs.
Push your hips forward to stand up, keeping your back flat all the way up.

name: Stomach Vacuum
cue: Breathe out, pull belly in, keep breathing
steps: Sit or stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Breathe in deeply.
Breathe out fully, pulling your belly button in towards your spine.
Keep your belly drawn in while you take small, normal breaths.
Breathe in and let your belly relax.

name: Superman
cue: Lift arms, chest and legs together
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower everything back down slowly.

name: The Straddle
cue: Legs wide, walk hands forward, back long
steps: Sit tall on the floor with your legs straight and wide apart in a V.
Put your hands on the floor in front of you.
Lean forward from your hips, walking your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Keep your back long and your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands back and sit up slowly.

name: Toe Reach Crunch
cue: Legs up, reach for toes, back down
steps: Lie on your back on the floor and raise your legs towards the ceiling, knees slightly soft.
Reach your arms up towards your feet.
Keeping your lower back pressed down, curl your shoulders up and reach towards your toes.
Lower your shoulders back down slowly, arms still reaching.

name: Cross-Body Triceps Stretch
cue: Arm across, hand over shoulder, ease elbow in
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Bring one arm across your body, bending the elbow so your hand reaches over your other shoulder.
Hold that elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow towards your other shoulder until you feel the stretch at the back of your arm.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
cue: Hand behind head, pull elbow gently
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Raise one arm, bend the elbow and reach that hand down behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow towards the back of your head until you feel the stretch.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Tuck Crunch
cue: Knees up, ankles crossed, curl shoulders up
steps: Lie on your back on the floor.
Cross your ankles and lift your legs until your thighs point up.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Keeping your lower back pressed down, curl your shoulders up.
Lower them back down slowly.

name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
cue: Hug your legs, chest towards knees
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front and your knees together.
Lean forward and wrap your arms under your thighs, hugging them.
Bring your chest down towards your knees until you feel the stretch, bending your knees slightly if you need to.
For more stretch in your upper back, gently pull your back away from your knees while holding on.
Let go and sit up slowly.

name: Upper Back Stretch
cue: Clasp hands, reach forward, round your back
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Clasp your fingers together with your thumbs pointing down.
Reach your hands forward, rounding your shoulders and upper back.
Let your head drop slightly and breathe.

name: Band Upright Row
cue: Elbows lead, hands stay close to body
steps: Sit or stand tall, with the middle of the band under both feet.
Hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Lead with your elbows to pull your hands up, close to your body.
Stop at chest height, with your elbows no higher than your shoulders.
Lower them slowly.

name: Upward Stretch
cue: Palms together, push up and back, back straight
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Raise both arms straight above your head, palms touching.
Slowly push your hands up and slightly back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your back straight, without arching your lower back.
Release slowly and lower your arms.

name: Vertical Swing
cue: Hips drive the swing, feet stay down
steps: Check you have clear space above and around you.
Stand with your feet wider than your hips, a light dumbbell in one hand hanging between your legs.
Push your hips back and swing the weight back between your legs, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to swing the weight up over your head, arm straight and feet on the floor.
Let it swing back down between your legs under control and finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Lying Windmill
cue: Leg across slowly, shoulders stay flat
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms out to the sides.
Lift one leg straight up, then lower it slowly across your body.
Reach your foot towards the floor near your opposite hand until you feel the stretch.
Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Bring the leg back up and down to the start, and keep alternating sides.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cue: Lunge, elbow to instep, then straighten front leg
steps: Step one foot forward into a long lunge, resting on the toes of your back foot.
Bend your front knee and lower your hips, keeping your chest up.
Place both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Lower your inside elbow towards your front instep until you feel the stretch.
Move your hands either side of the front foot and straighten that leg, toes up.
Step back up to standing slowly, then switch sides.

name: Wrist Circles
cue: Arms out wide, circle both wrists
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold your arms out to your sides, palms down.
Keeping your arms still, circle both wrists forwards.
Then circle them backwards the same number of times.

name: Zottman Curl
cue: Palms up to lift, palms down to lower
steps: Sit or stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl both dumbbells up, turning your palms up as they rise.
At the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower them slowly with your palms down.
Turn your palms back in at the bottom.

name: Calf Raise
cue: Rise onto your toes, lower slowly
steps: Stand tall facing your desk, feet hip-width apart.
Rest one hand on the desk for balance.
Rise slowly onto your toes.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

name: Chin Tuck
cue: Slide chin straight back, eyes stay level
steps: Sit or stand tall, looking straight ahead.
Glide your chin straight back, as if making a double chin.
Keep your eyes level; don't tip your head down.
Hold briefly, then let your head ease forward again.

name: Finger Spread
cue: Spread fingers wide, hold, then relax
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold both hands out in front of you, palms down.
Spread your fingers wide apart.
Hold briefly, then relax your hands.

name: Fist Clench and Spread
cue: Squeeze a tight fist, then spread wide
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold both hands out in front of you.
Make a tight fist with each hand.
Open your hands and spread your fingers wide.

name: Neck Rotation
cue: Turn to look over shoulder, shoulders stay still
steps: Sit or stand tall, looking straight ahead.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Come back through the centre and turn to look over the other shoulder.
Keep your shoulders still and your chin level.
Keep alternating sides.

name: Prayer Stretch
cue: Palms together, lower hands, elbows stay out
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Press your palms together in front of your chest, fingers pointing up.
Keeping your palms together, slowly lower your hands towards your waist.
Stop when you feel the stretch in your wrists, elbows out to the sides.
Release slowly and lower your arms.

name: Seated Cat-Cow
cue: Arch and lift chest, then round your back
steps: Sit near the front of your chair, feet flat and hands on your knees.
Breathe in, arch your back and lift your chest, looking slightly up.
Breathe out, round your back and let your chin drop towards your chest.
Move slowly between the two.

name: Palm-Down Wrist Stretch
cue: Palm down, press hand down, arm straight
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold one arm straight out in front of you, palm down.
With your other hand, gently press the back of that hand down towards you.
Stop when you feel the stretch along the top of your forearm.
Release slowly, then switch sides.

name: Palm-Up Wrist Stretch
cue: Palm up, pull fingers down, arm straight
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Hold one arm straight out in front of you, palm up.
With your other hand, gently pull the fingers down and back towards you.
Stop when you feel the stretch along the inside of your forearm.
Release slowly, then switch sides.
